items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 50:1
items.html: After the vessel of Malchut also broke, and the screen of Yeshsut became refined from every discernment of coarseness of the body that was in it, it turns out that it rose and was included in the coupling of the Rosh of Yeshsut. And since phase two, which is the last phase, disappeared, and nothing remained but the coarseness of phase one, therefore only the level of ZA emerged upon it, which is the discernment of Hesed and Gevura, called the two crowns of Da'at. (p. 559, Item 32)
